name: restore_vault_folder
description: Restores a folder from the Trash, by its ID from list_vault_trash, to where it was, or to toPath, whose folder must exist. Everything inside it comes back with it, except what was deleted on its own before. Restore files with restore_vault_file.

surfaceId.description: The vault Surface's ID, from list_surfaces. Must satisfy the required format.

toPath.description: Where to restore it, including its name. Must satisfy the required format.
